checkpoint_completeness.library: the runtime's own sigmoid DPO loop on the CosyVoice3 LLM (train_dpo.py, plain torch) with its cut writer (save_cut: llm.pt and base_ref.json, cut.json written last, atomic rename)
checkpoint_completeness.rule: a checkpoint-<N> directory is a cut iff its cut.json, written last before an atomic rename from .checkpoint-<N>.partial, parses with global_step = N and a positive integer pairs_consumed, deployable ["llm.pt"], and files listing exactly the other files of the directory (llm.pt, base_ref.json), each a plain file with its SHA-256; llm.pt is a zip archive (torch.save); .partial directories are never cuts; the cut's last step included is N
sources: runtime/train_dpo.py train (save_fn at every --save-every multiple and the last step)

trainer.seed_derivation: train_dpo.py set_seeds(S) seeds random, numpy and torch (CUDA included) with run_args.json `seed`, which must equal the launch record's training_seed and every cut's cut.json `seed`; the pair order is random.Random(f'dpo:{S}:{epoch}').shuffle per epoch (re-derived here and compared with samples.jsonl). Evaluation: gen_tts.py set_all_random_seed(derive_seed('tts', 11, item)) per item, the same noise for every arm; K = 1. bf16 autocast and cuDNN are not bit-reproducible, so a rerun gives other weights; 05 section 14 H(run_seed, step, data_ref, sample_index) is not claimed.
